confirmed_task:
Open the Smithsonian record for the Apollo 11 Command Module Columbia. Report its object name, museum, mission month and year stated in the Brief Description, complete Primary Materials field, complete Overall Dimensions field, and Inventory Number.

Stopping condition: Stop after the object name, museum, mission month and year, Primary Materials, Overall Dimensions, and Inventory Number have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the specified Smithsonian object record.
- Use the mission month and year from the Brief Description rather than a transfer or acquisition date.
- Report the Primary Materials and Overall Dimensions fields completely and preserve measurements exactly as displayed.
- Do not follow external links or attempt to obtain tickets.
